name: GoalJarFill
job: Show progress to a sales, donation or booking goal as an apothecary glass jar filling with liquid whose surface sloshes, with the raised amount and goal printed on the jar's paper label
visitor_action: none; moving the pointer across the jar sloshes the liquid, a tap makes a ripple, Enter swirls it when focused, and the cork pops when the goal is reached
mobile: jar centred, tap makes a ripple, no tilt slosh
motion: liquid rises with eased fill while the spring-wave surface sloshes and tilts, fine bubbles drift up and the amount counts; idle bubbles keep it alive; at 100% the cork pops with a spring overshoot, a fizz bursts, the caustics flare and a goal-reached pill springs in (reduced-motion: filled jar, still surface, frozen bubbles, cork resting open)

checks.render: compile-checked only (vite serves tsx/css/woff2 clean); screenshots skipped — shot.sh disabled by Guy 2026-11-23
checks.craft: not self-scored (shots disabled by Guy 2026-11-23); pending independent review

art_direction: Apothecary glass (warm-earned): amber syrup rising in thick clear glass on a sunlit apothecary shelf; refraction glints at the walls, a climbing meniscus, fine rising bubbles, golden caustics on the shelf; the cork pops open at 100%. Giant ink numeral behind the glass, cream paper label carries the type. Light mode.
